newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli industrial exports rise in March.
newsitem.headline: Israeli industrial exports rise in March.

text.p: Israeli industrial exports rose last month by 5.5 percent to $1.6 billion compared with March 1996, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Sunday.
In the first quarter of 1997, industrial exports increased by almost 6.7 percent to $4.47 billion against $4.19 billion in the same period a year earlier.

Industrial exports, excluding diamonds, rose 6.8 percent to $1.26 billion in March compared with March 1996. First-quarter industrial exports, excluding diamonds, climbed 7.8 percent to $3.34 billion compared with January-March 1996.
The ministry said exports of communications and medical equipment showed the strongest gains, followed by chemicals, fuel and electronic components.
